_doc: Config for scripts/harness_index.py. Keys starting with _ are comments. Ids are <kind>:<name> (agent:coder, skill:translate). Every agent/skill that produces work must map to a rubric AND an eval area (evals/<area>/task_template.yaml whose rubric: is that rubric); list it under exempt only when its output is not a deliverable (meta, router, judge, logging). Edit via a reviewed commit, like rubrics.

exempt.agent:orchestrator: router; its routing is scored through each specialist's area (any change re-runs the areas it routes to)
exempt.agent:verifier: judge; calibrated with human_scores in each eval set, never scored by itself
exempt.agent:librarian: meta: improvement loop; its proposals are gated by eval_gate.py
exempt.skill:fanout-plan: meta: planning block; outcomes are scored in the areas it fans out to
exempt.skill:handoff: meta: scored per note by rubrics/handoff.yaml cold-read test, not an eval area
exempt.skill:compact-prep: meta: session continuity (refreshes HANDOFF.md, scored by handoff.yaml)
exempt.skill:distill-principles: meta: improvement loop (approved by the user)
exempt.skill:pattern-review: meta: improvement loop; L3 encodings are gated by eval_gate.py
exempt.skill:style-guide: meta: proposes style rules; they are gated through the translation eval set
exempt.skill:backcatalog: meta: imports past work as proposals
exempt.skill:self-eval: meta: runs the eval sets themselves
